name: oleksyuk-agent-skills
description: Maks Oleksyuk's collection of Claude Code skills, each installable on its own.

plugins.name: ddev
plugins.description: Teaches Claude that the project runs inside DDEV, so commands (composer, php, npm, artisan, drush, wp) run in the containers instead of failing on the host.

plugins.name: mantine-headless-tailwind
plugins.description: Rules for UI components on Mantine in headless mode styled with Tailwind via tailwind-variants: no Mantine CSS, slots and data-* states, prop types derived from the styles via satisfies, React Compiler-friendly structure, tests and a demo page.
